title: A bandit survivor begs for mercy.
description: Bloodied, kneeling. He'll talk if pressed — or die in silence if you let him.

onPass.narration: He spills everything. Their camp lies east of the road. You note it for later.

onFail.narration: He spits at your boots and dies refusing.

onPass.narration: He talks freely, almost grateful. Their camp lies east of the road.

onFail.narration: He distrusts you and stays silent.

onPass.narration: You let him go. He scrambles away, swearing he'll never raid the road again.
